description: The signed-in Lemma workspace runs on a remote origin - the locald-served local app URL, or the hosted site - so it reaches the shell only through this capability. It grants opening Local settings, controlling this computer's Agent Host, and pointing this installation at an AI provider, because those are the surfaces a user meets during onboarding and cannot be sent to another window to complete. Provider configuration is deliberately the only operator setting here: it reaches config.set-ai, which merges that one section and cannot touch sharing, tunnels, runtime, or diagnostics. Shared LAN and public-tunnel origins are different hosts and are deliberately not listed, so a visitor's browser matches nothing.
